about: The posture pass after every clip (50-figure.js posture, kchar_figure.gd _posture), per body: Spine, Spine1, Spine2, Neck and Head pitched by these degrees in the figure's frame (negative forward, positive back), then the shoulders dropped (drop) and drawn back (back, negative rolls them forward). 'frame': 'joint' takes each spine joint's side axis as the clip has turned its parent from rest (a twisted or side-leaning torso bends forward along its own facing; it is the figure's axis on an upright one), 'figure' the figure's own side axis (before 2026-10-20: the man's ribs kinked sideways in twisted idles); the shoulders always turn in the figure's frame. The upper arms keep the way the clip points them. A body without an entry takes mpfb_male's (the giant). 'clips': per clip key, per body, degrees added to the body's values while that clip plays (blended through a cross-fade); kept under the body whose values a body takes (the giant: mpfb_male). The Animation Lab's Posture panel edits both live ('Every clip' and 'This clip') and copies them as this object.
